Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

magComp 0.0.6

Initial public release.

  • Fit magnitude and composition models together or separately, using a negative-binomial model for total counts and multinomial allocation among one or two categorical variables.
  • Specify separate covariates for magnitude, leading allocation, and conditional allocation. Include group, spatial, or space-time effects in intercepts and slopes.
  • Represent dependence among composition categories with shared latent factors and smooth coefficients across ordered classes.
  • Use GP or NNGP terms with exponential, Matérn, separable space-time, multiresolution, or Gneiting covariance functions. Covariance parameters have automatic defaults and can be estimated or fixed individually.
  • Inspect posterior draws and chain diagnostics through samples(), summary(), and plot(), including combined coefficients and effects.
  • Obtain fitted values and predictions for expected quantities or simulated observations. Aggregate density draws to reporting areas with standSummary(), and assess models with posterior predictive checks and cross-validation.
  • Follow worked Quarto articles with downloadable data, from individual components to models with group, spatial, and space-time effects.

Developed by Andrew O. Finley.
